events.address: North Esplanade by The Rink, 45 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW beauty activation for Sally Hansen's Miracle Gel Bold Glam collection with nail touch-ups, photo moments and opportunities to try the new shades.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the activation, including nail touch-ups and photo moments. No specific take-home product is guaranteed by the verified sources.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center lists the activation within its free NYFW programming, and a current event listing explicitly describes it as open to the public. Normal capacity and on-site rules can still apply.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–6 PM and Sunday, September 13 from 10 AM–6 PM on the North Esplanade by The Rink. No advance RSVP requirement is published.

events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW pop-up where guests can refresh their look, create content and explore Calzedonia legwear between shows.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary coffee, branded stickers, a photo booth, hairstyle touch-ups and skincare sampling are advertised. Hand embroidery is free only with purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: Current independent event listings agree that the pop-up is open to the public. Embroidery is not a no-purchase freebie: it requires purchase of the specified knee highs. Samples and other promotional items remain subject to availability.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 and Sunday, September 13 from 12–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is published in the verified listings.
